notes.title: Outer Storms at the Steam Next Fest (postponed)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First of all, thank you so much for adding Outer Storms to your wishlist. Your support means a lot to me!

I’m sorry to announce that I have to postpone Outer Storms' participation in the Steam Next Fest for February 2025. After careful consideration, I’ve realized that there isn’t enough time left to deliver a demo that meets the quality I’m aiming for.

Instead of rushing, I’ve decided to take a bit more time to refine Outer Storms. My goal is to provide you with an experience that meets your expectations, and this will require additional adjustments in various areas of the game.

I’m still excited and fully committed to the development of the game, and I’m confident that this extra time will be well worth it. I’ll keep you updated on the progress, and the demo will be available as soon as I’m satisfied with its quality.

Stay tuned, the journey is far from over!

See you soon,

The Outer Storms Team (or just me, depending on your preference)

notes.title: Outer Storms at the Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I’m excited to announce that Outer Storms will be participating in the Steam Next Fest in February 2025! This is the perfect opportunity to give you a first look at the game and immerse you in its unique universe.

Right now, I’m focusing on two key aspects of the game: the energy system and terrain terraforming. Energy management is at the heart of the experience, influencing your actions and strategies. As for terraforming, it will allow you to colonize environments, whether by carefully cleansing them or annihilating everything with force.

These elements will be featured in the demo, so you can explore how they work and how they impact gameplay. I’m also working on the visual and sound aspects to enhance the immersion and ensure every detail contributes to the game’s atmosphere.

A trailer will be available soon to give you a sneak peek of what’s to come. I can’t wait to share this demo with you during the Steam Next Fest and hear your feedback!

Stay tuned, and see you soon!
